newsitem.title: USA: Emery North American volume up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: Emery North American volume up 40 pct.

text.p: Following the Teamsters strike at United Parcel Service of America Inc, Emery Worldwide's package volume has increased 40 percent in North American and 10 percent internationally, Emery chief executive David Beatson told CNBC.
Emery, part of CNF Transportation Inc, said it has added additional aircraft to handle the growing demand.
"Our first priority is to our current customers. We are taking additional customers as space permits," Beatson said in an interview on CNBC.

The Teamsters strike at UPS entered its third day on Wednesday, as pressure increased for the union and the package delivery company to restart stalled labor talks. UPS said it expects its revenues and earnings to be adversely affected by strike.
